title: Loudest Mayor 📢
rule: The loudest kid in town becomes mayor for a day.
description: In this town the loudest kid rules. I am the quietest kid there is.

beats.text: In this town, the loudest kid becomes the mayor for a day.
Every morning in the park, everyone shouts at the sky as hard as they can.
And every single day, the same kid wins. Rocky, the kid with the megaphone voice.
I'm Leo, the quietest kid in school, so nobody ever hears my name.
Rocky's first rule as mayor: candy for loud kids, nothing for quiet kids.
So my little sister Mia and I made a plan to beat him.
On contest day, Rocky took the biggest breath of his life.
He screamed so hard that his voice cracked, and then it was gone.
The principal said the next loudest kid wins. Nobody made a sound.
Then Mia pointed at me, and the whole crowd turned.
My first law: free candy for every quiet kid in town.
But this morning, Rocky whispered one sentence in my ear, and I heard every word.
